# Self-hosted website fonts

These unmodified font binaries are served locally. The website does not request
fonts from an external CDN.

All files were obtained from the official [Google Fonts repository](https://github.com/google/fonts)
at commit `47d54ca1ebb14fd864695f1d39dc734f39017c33`.
Each family is distributed under the SIL Open Font License, Version 1.1, in its
accompanying `*-OFL.txt` file. Those copyright notices and licenses must accompany
redistributed copies of these fonts. The website's MIT license does not replace
the font licenses.

| Local file | CSS family | Style | Variable weight range | Bytes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `SpaceGrotesk-Variable.ttf` | `Space Grotesk` | normal | 300–700 | 136676 |
| `Manrope-Variable.ttf` | `Manrope` | normal | 200–800 | 164700 |
| `JetBrainsMono-Variable.ttf` | `JetBrains Mono` | normal | 100–800 | 187208 |

The local filenames were simplified; the binary contents are unchanged.
